name: AIONS File Modification Guard
description: Wymusza sprawdzenie zależności przed modyfikacją pliku

actions.content:
## ⚠️ FILE MODIFICATION CHECK

Before modifying this file, ensure you have:

1. Called `project_file_deps('${target_file}')` to see dependencies
2. Read the current file content
3. Verified the modification won't break dependent files

After modification:
- Log the change via `conv_log('assistant', 'Modified ${target_file}: [description]')`
